meta.labels: MEASURED = computed here or reused from a committed file; ASSUMED = input, proxy or simplification. No reanalysis was used, so nothing is ASSUMED PERFECT FORECAST.

forecast.gfs: issued GFS 0.25 deg, cycles 00/06/12/18 UTC, assumed available 5 h after the cycle, leads 6-18 h (fires with issue hours from 2021-01-01)
forecast.hrrr: issued HRRR 3 km box-averaged to the 0.25 deg lattice, same cycles, delay and leads (US fires before 2021)

gfs_KOR.byte_ranges: from the .idx file of each forecast hour; 7 fields; leads 6-18 h

gfs_WUS.byte_ranges: from the .idx file of each forecast hour; 7 fields; leads 6-18 h

hrrr_WUS.byte_ranges: from the .idx file of each forecast hour; 7 fields; leads 6-18 h

products.GOFER: hourly GOFER perimeters, kcf-margin reach reused (MEASURED)
products.DET: 25 March 2025 FIRMS VIIRS + AHI detection union, kcf-margin reach reused (detections, not perimeters: ASSUMED proxy)
products.CHOI: Choi et al. 2026 kriged arrival rasters (retrospective reconstruction, smooth in time), reach computed here (MEASURED on the reconstruction)

h5.rates_label: fire-weighted, MEASURED on Choi kriged rasters

h8.rates_label: fire-weighted, MEASURED on Choi kriged rasters

test_fires_not_tested.KFS_09: no eligible issue hour (arrival span 2022-04-10 18:00:00 .. 2022-04-10 18:00:00 UTC is shorter than 5 h + 1)
test_fires_not_tested.KFS_14: no eligible issue hour (arrival span 2022-05-28 18:00:00 .. 2022-05-28 18:00:00 UTC is shorter than 5 h + 1)
test_fires_not_tested.KFS_16: no eligible issue hour (arrival span 2023-04-03 05:00:00 .. 2023-04-03 05:00:00 UTC is shorter than 5 h + 1)

data.source: kcf-margin/derived/gofer_reach.csv.gz, h = 5, reach_km (5 km rule), max over each fire's eligible issue hours
data.label: MEASURED

fires_needed_to_bound.rule: n = ceil(ln 0.05 / ln(1 - p40)): fires with no exceedance needed for a one-sided 95% upper bound at p40 (about 3 / p40)

trust.verdict: fit cannot bound the 40 km return period with 28 fires (profile interval for p40 reaches 0)
